name: Siphon Life
description:
Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing 





spirit damage over time and 



healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

name: Shoulder Charge
description:
Charge forward, 




pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies 












stun.If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.

name: Infernal Resilience
description:
Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary 



regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.

name: Seismic Impact
description:
Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing 





spirit damage and applying 












stun.

name: Disengaging Sigil
description: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.

name: Riposte
description: Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, immobilizing and disarming them, preventing them from parrying, and reducing their Melee Resist.Press Ability 2 to select a target.Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.

name: Flawless Advance
description: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage.Press Ability 3 to re-cast.

name: Itani Lo Sahn
description:
Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies.While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage.Hold Ability 4 or 






 to delay the cast.

name: Threadsap
description:
Weave a scraggly thread that follows your crosshair before bursting along its path, dealing 





spirit damage and stealing enemy 


Spirit, increased in effectiveness for Baba.While holding stolen 


Spirit, Baba deals 





bonus spirit damage with every bullet.

name: Granny Long Legs
description:
Your bench's legs extend, granting 


bonus move speed, higher jumps, Debuff Resistance and Melee Resistance.Light Melee: Perform a kick that knocks enemies back.Heavy Melee: Perform a ground pound that applies 




knockup, slow, and deals 





spirit damage.Hold Crouch / slide to charge a high jump, release to jump.

name: Baba's Brew
description:
Brew a pot of tea that applies a magical effect in an area when thrown, cycling over time in a random order between a soothing barrier, 



Silence, or scalding burn that deals 





spirit damage over time and reduces spirit resist. Press 






 to pause or resume brewing.

name: Feed The Birds
description:
Cover targets in front of you with bread, adding a stacking slow .When the channel ends a flock of pigeons bombard the targets, dealing 





spirit damage and hexing each target into a pigeon, increasing in both damage and duration based on bread count.

name: Exploding Uppercut
description:
Deal melee damage to nearby enemies and apply 




knockback. When they land, they deal 





spirit damage and apply 


reduced fire rate to other nearby enemies. Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.

name: Sticky Bomb
description:
Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing 





spirit damage to nearby enemies. If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb. Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills

name: Grapple Arm
description:
Launch out a mechanical hand that 




pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in. Grapple Arm can be used on allies.

name: Hyper Beam
description:
Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals 





spirit damage and applies slow.

name: Bashdown
description:
Slam your bat into the ground, 




pulling enemies down and dealing melee damage.The slam creates a shockwave that deals 





spirit damage and applies 




knockup.

name: Rising Ram
description: Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.

name: Blasted
description: Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.

name: Chain Gang
description:
Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain.After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal 





spirit damage.The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.

name: Gloom Bombs
description:
Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing 





spirit damage.Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.

name: Leaping Slash
description:
Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing melee damage. If the ability hits at least one hero, 



heal a small amount of health.

name: Ava
description:
Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain 


bonus move speed that increases over time, and become  hidden on the minimap. Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.

name: Return to Shadows
description:
Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining 


bonus move speed, and dealing 





spirit damage. After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing 





spirit damage again.

name: Light Eater
description:
Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take 





spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.

name: Dazzling Trick
description: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.

name: Radiant Daggers
description:
Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals 





spirit damage to all targets in the area. Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

name: Shining Wonder
description:
Launch a deadly orb of light that deals 





spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.

name: Strix Salvo
description:
Launch a salvo of spirit missiles that lodge into the ground along a line. The missiles explode after a delay or upon detecting an enemy, dealing 





spirit damage and marking the target.Shooting a marked enemy with a charged shot consumes a mark to deal 





bonus spirit damage and apply a fading slow.Hold and drag to select the angle.

name: Chimera Mk1
description: Hold Jump / mantle to fly, building up heat. When max heat is reached, your jetpack will begin to overheat.Overheating: After a short delay, dive to the ground. Upon impact, create an explosion that deals damage and launches you and nearby enemies. If no hero is hit, you stun yourself. Press Ability 2 to dive early.Cooling Down: After overheating, the jetpack cannot be used until it fully cools down.Slows affect you while airborne. You always explode on death.

name: Jettison Fuel
description:
Spray fuel dealing 





weapon damage over time and shredding bullet resist, building up to a huge backblast that deals 





spirit damage and knocks you backwards.Vents the jetpack when dealing damage.

name: Close The Deal
description:
Grab an enemy and give them a hands-on demonstration, flying high into the air before crashing back to the ground.You and the participant take 





spirit damage over time while falling and 





spirit damage upon impact. Damage is increased to enemies under 50% health.

name: Rend
description:
Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing 





spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.

name: Stalker's Mark
description:
Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing 





spirit damage over time.While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.

name: Eternal Night
description:
Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration.You gain 


bonus sprint speed.

name: Kinetic Pulse
description:
Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing 





spirit damage and applying 




knockup.

name: Quantum Entanglement
description:
Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use. 






: Bring nearby allies with you.

name: Rejuvenating Aurora
description: While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby.You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.

name: Singularity
description:
Create a singularity in your hands, dealing 





spirit damage over time, applying 












stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.

name: Jar of Dead
description:
Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead.Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal 





spirit damage to enemies. Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.

name: Grasping Hands
description:
Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take 





spirit damage and receive immobilize. Alt-Cast 






 rotates the orientation of the wall.

name: Essence Theft
description:
Your weapon steals 





weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.

name: Charged Shot
description:
Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or 






 to hold the shot.

name: Rain of Arrows
description:
Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon. 






for reduced jump height. Press Jump / mantle to cancel the glide.

name: Spirit Snare
description: Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage.Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.

name: Guided Owl
description: After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold [W] to accelerate the owl.Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.

name: Sleep Dagger
description: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.

name: Fixation
description: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.

name: Bullet Dance
description: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.

name: Powder Keg
description:
Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing 





spirit damage, setting enemies on fire and applying 




knockup.  The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel. The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage.Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel in front of Holliday.

name: Bounce Pad
description: Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero. You explode on landing, dealing  Damage to any nearby enemies. The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.

name: Crackshot
description: Headshots deal bonus  Damage and applies a  Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown. Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits. Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.

name: Spirit Lasso
description:
Throw out your lasso, dealing 





spirit damage, 




pulling, and applying 












stun.Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.

name: Napalm
description:
Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing 





spirit damage, applying slow, and coating targets in napalm.

name: Flame Dash
description:
Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals 





spirit damage over time. Hold [W] while active to dash farther.

name: Afterburn
description:
Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing 





spirit damage over time. Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.

name: Concussive Combustion
description:
Become a living bomb, dealing 





spirit damage and applying 












stun to all nearby enemies after a delay.Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.

name: Entangling Thorns
description: Summon a patch of choking thorns that damages and slows enemies in its radius.

name: Kudzu Connection
description: Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting.Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connectionConnection requires line of sight.

name: Stone Form
description: Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.

name: Air Drop
description:
Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing 





spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends. Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies.Taking damage briefly disables using the ability.While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.

name: Frost Grenade
description:
Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that 



heals allies and applies 





spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.

name: Ice Path
description: Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail. Press Dash / Crouch / slide to travel up or down while in Ice Path.

name: Arctic Beam
description: Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.

name: Frozen Shelter
description:
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid 



regeneration and enemies are slowed. Objectives become Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter

name: Essence Bomb
description: Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time.Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.

name: Life Drain
description:
Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced. 






 to give health to friendly Heroes.

name: Malice
description: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.

name: Soul Exchange
description: Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.

name: Ground Strike
description: Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.

name: Grapple
description: Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes.

name: Flog
description:
Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, 



healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

name: Death Slam
description:
Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed. Press






to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.

name: Mini Turret
description:
Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing 





spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime.Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.

name: Medicinal Specter
description:
Deploy a spirit that provides 



healing to nearby allies.

name: Spectral Wall
description:
Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies. After casting, press






or Ability 3 to erupt the wall early. Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks

name: Heavy Barrage
description: Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location. McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.

name: Sanguine Retreat
description: Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location. Can be recast within a brief window.

name: Love Bites
description:
Your bullets apply additional 





spirit damage. Dealing damage with your abilities builds up to a vicious bite, dealing a burst of 





bonus spirit damage. Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.

name: Nox Nostra
description:
Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing 





spirit damage and applying 



Silence.Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.

name: Fire Scarabs
description: Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.

name: Dust Devil
description: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies, slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion.

name: Djinn's Mark
description: Active: Consume all Djinn Marks to deal their damage now.

name: Traveler
description: Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage or being Stunned, Immobilized, put to Sleep or Movement Silenced during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.After teleporting, gain a Barrier.

name: Scorn
description: Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.

name: Burrow
description:
Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus. When you jump out, deal 





spirit damage, slow, and 




knockup.

name: Sand Blast
description: Spray sand that disarms enemies in front of you and deals damage.

name: Combo
description: Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.

name: Leech Therapy
description:
Throw a jar of leeches that attach to enemies, dealing 





spirit damage over time and eating away at the duration of enemy buffs.

name: Wretched Vapors
description: Crack open a vial to release an ethereal vapor onto yourself or an ally that causes a rush, then a crash.Specter Rush: While it lasts, increases the speed of all actions and temporarily numbs all incoming damage creating looming specters.Specter Crash: When the vapors wear off, all actions are slower and any remaining specters deal their delayed damage plus extra damage.Incoming healing will prioritize removing specters first, preventing them from dealing damage.

name: Healing Needles
description:
Load your weapon with a full clip of syringes that 



heal allies. Dealing damage recovers charges, and each leech you have collected slowly restores them.Reloading spends a charge for a fresh clip.Unused syringes are refunded as a partial charge. Recast to put them away.

name: Lurking Terrors
description:
Open your bag and reveal the horrors you carry inside, dealing 





spirit damage over time to enemies in front of you. Enemies looking at you build up terror and cannot use stamina or movement abilities. At max terror, they flee in fear away from you.Each leech you have collected adds fear duration.Enemies facing away from you take 50% damage unless feared.

name: Bookwyrm
description:
Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing 





spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.

name: Plot Armor
description:
Grant an ally a barrier. While the barrier holds, they gain 





bonus weapon damage.

name: Captivating Read
description:
Target an area with latent magic, applying slow. The magic detonates after a delay, dealing 





spirit damage and applying immobilize.

name: Rallying Charge
description:
Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, 



healing allies and dealing 





spirit damage to enemies. The strength of the 



heal and 





spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.

name: Pulse Grenade
description:
Throw a grenade that begins pulsing when it lands. Each pulse expands the radius and applies 





spirit damage, time slow, and stacking 


increased damage for Paradox against the victim.

name: Time Wall
description: Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets. Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed.

name: Kinetic Carbine
description:
Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing 





spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with 





weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging. While in the air and charging, 






 to timeslow your movement.

name: Paradoxical Swap
description: Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.

name: Barrage
description:
Channel to start launching projectiles that deal 





spirit damage and apply slow around their impact point. Projectiles that hit a hero grant Pocket 


increased damage that stacks.Casting while airborne will cause Pocket to float.Casting AirDash or Flying Cloak will not cancel Barrage.

name: Flying Cloak
description: Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press  Ability 2  to teleport to its location.

name: Enchanter's Satchel
description:
Escape into your suitcase. When the duration ends, deal 





spirit damage to nearby enemies. Duration can be ended early by performing any action.

name: Affliction
description:
Applies 





damage over time to enemies nearby.Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

name: Scrap Grenade
description:
Throw a grenade of scrap that detonates multiple times, dealing 





bullet damage and applying slow.The grenade can be meleed to knock it away.

name: Rat Swarm
description:
Call forth a swarm of rats that leap onto enemies, dealing 





spirit damage over time and reducing their bullet resist with every bite. The more rats are attached, the faster they will bite the target.Enemies can have multiple rats attached, but can shake off a rat early by performing a ground or air dash.

name: Royal Pestments
description:
Adorn scrappy armor, gaining barrier based on your 



max health. As long as the armor holds, bullets have a chance to be deflected back towards the attacker.The barrier does not benefit from resists.

name: Rule, Ratannia!
description:
Charge up and summon the banner of Ratannia, granting all nearby allies increased 


move speed, immunity from slows, and reduced incoming damage while near the banner.

name: Pillow Toss
description:
Throw your trusty pillow inflicting 





spirit damage and heavy 




knockback.Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

name: Tag Along
description:
Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst 



heal based on missing health followed by lingering 



regeneration.Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally.You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability.You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.

name: Lil Helpers
description:
Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers.Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading 


move speed.Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team.Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.

name: Naptime
description:
Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities.When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy 





spirit damage.

name: Lightning Ball
description: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.

name: Static Charge
description: Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.

name: Power Surge
description: Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.

name: Storm Cloud
description: Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.

name: Serrated Knives
description: Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.

name: Slice and Dice
description: Perform a dash forward, damaging enemies along the path. Hit Enemies have their spirit resist reduced. This debuff can stack.

name: Bloodletting
description: Take only a portion of incoming damage immediately and defer the rest to be taken over time. Activate to clear a portion of the deferred damage.

name: Slam Fire
description:
Instantly reload your gun. You gain 


bonus fire rate and deal bonus 





weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy.Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.

name: Entangling Bola
description:
Throw a bola, dealing 





spirit damage, applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.

name: Lycan Curse
description:
Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse.Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased 



max health, and stacking 


fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.

name: Vexing Bolt
description: Fire a bolt of magic that deals  Damage, increasing as it travels. If you have an Assistant, they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage. Press  Ability 1  to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.

name: Spectral Assistant
description: Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing  Damage. While the Assistant is out, you can press  Ability 2  to swap positions with your Assistant. Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.

name: Rabbit Hex
description: Hex a target area and transform all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration. Rabbits are small and  move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions.Hex does not interrupt abilities.

name: Audience Participation
description: Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead.Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points.Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.

name: Setup Bishop
description:
Create a bishop that remains in place indefinitely. Move (






): Moves the bishop, applying a fading slow and dealing 





spirit damage to enemies it passes through. After a delay, activates diagonal squares that deal additional 





spirit damage when stepped on.Re-activate to recall all bishops, ending the ability.

name: Kingside Knight
description:
Promote an ally to be a knight, granting bonus stamina and barrier for a duration.If self-cast you develop yourself as king instead, granting double the barrier but no stamina. Move (






): Moves the piece, making it invulnerable during the duration before landing. If self-cast, re-activate the ability to move instead.

name: Rook Battery
description:
Release a pair of rooks that travel forward, dealing 





spirit damage and applying immobilize. If the rooks hit a wall, they reflect back in the opposite direction. Re-Activate: Split the rooks perpendicularly.

name: Call Bell
description:
Throw out a call bell that deals 





spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional 





spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow.Can be shot to detonate early.

name: Doorway
description: Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration.The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.

name: Luggage Cart
description:
Send out a Luggage Cart that deals 





spirit damage and 




pulls enemy heroes along its path. Can be alt cast with 






 to target friendly heroes instead.

name: Hotel Guest
description:
Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position. A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in 





spirit damage. Failure to check-out on time costs additional 





spirit damage.

name: Consecrating Grenade
description:
Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing 





weapon damage and setting enemies on fire. Burning targets deal 



pure damage to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing.

name: Gutshot
description:
Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing 





weapon damage and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive 












stun and take 





bonus weapon damage.

name: Hex-Lined Snap Trap
description:
Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay. The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing 





spirit damage, applying immobilize, and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.

name: Ira Domini
description:
Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased 





weapon damage.The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus 



pure damage and executing low-health enemies.

name: Pain Battery
description:
Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery. Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing 





spirit damage once per target.

name: Jumpstart
description:
Deal 





spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus 



regeneration and 


bonus move speed, decaying over time.

name: Aura of Suffering
description:
Unleash pain, dealing 





spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself. The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.

name: Shocking Reanimation
description:
Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow. After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing 





spirit damage and applying 












stun to nearby enemies.

name: Stake
description: Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.

name: Flight
description: Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.

name: Crow Familiar
description: Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.

name: Assassinate
description: Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1.0s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.

name: Flow State
description:
Drag a brush that continues to travel forward, leaving a trail that grants bonus slide distance for allies and a fading slow and 





spirit damage to enemies it passes through, increased the further it travels. Re-activate the ability to flick the brush forward, ending the ability early but dealing 





spirit damage in a larger area.

name: Still Life
description:
Choose a hero to be your subject, dealing 





spirit damage over time as long as you are looking at them. If the sketch is completed they take additional 





spirit damage, suffer from 












stun, and drop a sketch that can be picked up. For each collected sketch, you permanently gain stats based on the hero.

name: Abstract Landscape
description:
Create a circular display of ink that blocks vision and grants allies 


Spirit.Enemies inside are revealed, and leaving causes them to take 





spirit damage and suffer from 



Silence and slow, destroying the ink in the process.

name: Splatter
description: Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.

name: The Cube
description: Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press  Jump / mantle  to escape early.

name: Puddle Punch
description:
Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying 




knockup. Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow. Enemies can Parry this attack.You and your allies have increased Air Control.

name: Goo Ball
description: Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.

name: Screwjab Dagger
description:
Throw a dagger, dealing 





spirit damage and applying slow. Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in 





spirit damage and slow.

name: Lethal Venom
description: Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health.Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.

name: Slither
description: You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.

name: Petrifying Bola
description: Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola  Slows and  Damages all enemies in the area. Direct hits deal  Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.

name: Alchemical Flask
description: Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.

name: Willpower
description: Gain a Barrier and bonus move speed.

name: Binding Word
description: Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time, they will be damaged and immobilized.

name: Last Stand
description: After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done. While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.Immune to fear while Last Stand is active.

name: Card Trick
description: Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending on its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair. Alt-cast to throw first card

name: Project Mind
description: Teleport to the targeted location.

name: Full Auto
description:
Temporarily boost your fire rate and deal bonus 





spirit damage

name: Telekinesis
description: Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location.

name: Power Slash
description:
Channel to increase damage over 1.4 seconds, then release a fully-charged sword strike.Press Ability 1 or






to trigger the strike early, dealing partial damage.

name: Flying Slash
description: Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealingmelee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.

name: Crimson Slash
description: Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.

name: Shadow Transformation
description: Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster. You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.
